postconditions.statement: For every allowed input and row (g,k), if count(g,k)>0 then value(g,k)=sum(g,k). If count(g,k)=0 and fill=none then value(g,k)=null. If count(g,k)=0 and fill=previous, let j be the greatest index less than k with count(g,j)>0: value(g,k)=sum(g,j) if such j exists, otherwise null. Previous state is group-local, initially null, updated by every nonempty bucket including a zero sum, unchanged by empty buckets, and never seeded by events before start. The arity-1 solve in canonical program.vscore.json universally implements these formulas with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.
